q: Which plan is right for me?
a: Kickstart suits a polished manuscript that needs to become a book. Level-Up adds copy editing, three cover concepts and an eBook. Pro is a full launch with extensive editing, colour options, an audiobook and paid advertising. Take the 30-second plan quiz on the Plans page, or book a free consultation.

q: Are prices inclusive of GST?
a: No. Plan prices are shown excluding GST; 18% GST is added at checkout and itemised on your quote and invoice.

q: What if my book is longer than 350 pages?
a: Each plan includes formatting for approximately 350 pages. Longer manuscripts are welcome — formatting beyond that is a small add-on per 100 pages.

q: Can I upgrade my plan later?
a: Yes. You can upgrade at any point before production finishes and pay only the difference.

q: How much royalty do I earn?
a: You earn a better share of the profit on every sale — calculated from the retail price minus the printing cost and the retailer's share. There are no hidden deductions.

q: How often are royalties paid?
a: Kickstart and Level-Up pay out annually; Pro pays out quarterly. Every payout comes with a transparent sales statement in your dashboard.

q: Who owns the copyright?
a: You do — always. Our agreement is non-exclusive, so you remain free to publish your work elsewhere.

q: Do I get an ISBN?
a: Yes. Every plan includes an ISBN and a retail barcode.

q: How do I sign the agreement?
a: Digitally. Once you confirm your plan we send a secure link; it takes a couple of minutes to review and sign.

q: Where will my book be sold?
a: On national online stores (such as Amazon.in and Flipkart), global channels, the StoryShelf Store, and via print-on-demand. Level-Up and Pro add Google Play and EPUB distribution.

q: What is print-on-demand (POD)?
a: Copies are printed when they are ordered, so your book never goes out of stock and there is no warehouse or wasted inventory.

q: How long until my book is live?
a: Typically 6–8 weeks from signing, depending on how much editing is needed and how quickly you approve designs and proofs.

q: Will editors change my voice?
a: No. Edits are suggestions in tracked changes. You accept, reject or discuss each one — the final text is always yours.

q: What if I don't like the cover concepts?
a: Tell us why. Your designer refines the concepts based on your feedback; we iterate until the cover feels right.

q: Can I have colour pages?
a: Full-colour interiors are available on the Pro plan — ideal for children's books, cookbooks and photo-rich non-fiction.

q: How do I pay?
a: UPI, cards, net banking or EMI. You can pay in two instalments: on signing and on approval of the final proofs.

q: Is there a refund policy?
a: If you cancel before work starts you receive a full refund. After that, refunds are pro-rated to the stages not yet delivered.

q: Who do I contact during publishing?
a: Your dedicated Publication Manager. You can also chat with us, raise a ticket from your dashboard, call, or message us on WhatsApp.

q: Do you help after my book is published?
a: Yes — post-publication assistance is included in every plan: corrections, reprints, listing updates and marketing advice.

q: What are your support hours?
a: Monday to Saturday, 9:30 am – 7:00 pm IST. Tickets raised outside these hours are answered the next working day.
